full_judgment: 9. By the way, it may be observed that the High Court Division is not correct in its view that the limitation to have an ex parte decree set aside on the ground of fraud is 30 days. It is Article 95 of the First Schedule to the Limitation Act which governs a suit to set aside a decree obtained by fraud or for other relief on the ground of fraud. It provides 3 years from the time when fraud becomes known to the party wronged.
